description: Aircraft currently ARRIVING at an airport — live ADS-B, no key required. Pass an ICAO code (e.g. "KSFO", "EGLL") and get inbound traffic descending toward the field, nearest first, with callsign, registration, aircraft type, altitude, descent rate and distance out. Use for "what is landing at <airport> right now", "inbound traffic to <airport>". This is a live picture, not a scheduled timetable. (Historical windows via begin/end require OpenSky credentials and only work when self-hosting — OpenSky is unreachable from cloud egress.)

airport.description: ICAO airport code, e.g. "KJFK", "EGLL", "KSFO" (4 letters, not the 3-letter IATA code)

begin.description: OPTIONAL historical window start (Unix seconds). Requires OpenSky credentials and only works when self-hosting; omit for live data.

end.description: OPTIONAL historical window end (Unix seconds, max 7 days after begin). Omit for live data.

limit.description: Max aircraft to return (1-200, default 50), nearest first.

radius_nm.description: How far out to look, nautical miles (1-250, default 40).

name: get_arrivals

first_seen.description: Unix timestamp of first radar contact

last_seen.description: Unix timestamp of last radar contact

title: Get Arrivals
